entities.title: Features
entities.summary: Behaviours built from capabilities, each with its feature document beside the code.
entities.purpose: Groups lodestar-core's middle layer: death, docking, the escape pod, hyperspace, the in-system jump, the planet and sun, saving, spawning, the station and trading. The fly-in-a-system use case calls them in RULES' order.
boundaries: A feature never uses a use case (tests/layers.rs); features may use one another and the capabilities.
